name: mmo-extension
description: MixAI Connector — browser extension (Chrome/Firefox MV3) that connects the browser to your MixAI Server: one-click 'MixAI' button on streaming sites, opens /download in the MixAI web app. Vendored deps live in vendor/, design tokens in tokens.css (generated), icons in icons/ (generated by brand/scripts/build.mjs).
